objective: Under G18, a short scoping study at the coordinator's pick: under a count weighting, when a reader's statistics are written through the signed form of the count, do terms cancel in a way that depends on a far reader's free setting, or is the signed form only a rewriting of a nonnegative count?
status: Complete 2026-11-26 (a negative with a reason; referee pending): under a count weighting the signed form is only a rewriting; a far edit can move a near statistic, but the edited count is the unedited count plus the count with the far knot deleted (a nonnegative mixture), so a reader sees only its own statistic change; a signed sum that is not a count exists only in supplied readings that square it.
title: Signed counts: does the signed form of a count show a reader anything?
